note: Mode-based token architecture as of 2026-08-05 — every semantic color token below carries a base "value" (its On Light resolution, also what tokens.css's @theme block registers) and, for tokens whose value actually differs by mode, a "modes" object with "dark"/"feature" overrides. Mode-invariant tokens (the majority of surface/*, plus action-highlight(-hover), text-on-highlight, text-on-state, state-hover, border-focus-on-highlight) have no "modes" key — there's nothing to override. See tokens.css's own header comment for the override mechanism and design-system-rules.md §7 for the full per-mode table.

primary.note: Button primary variant's fill. Inverted in the 2026-08-05 sync — was light cream (#f8ebda) at all times, now dark on Light mode / light on Dark/Feature. A real visual redesign, not a rename — verified against a live Figma screenshot before shipping (see PR).

secondary.note: Transparent, mode-invariant. Aliases Alpha/White-0 in Figma. Button secondary variant's fill in its default state. Not yet wired to a component via this token name — Secondary uses a literal bg-transparent.

secondary-hover.note: Button secondary variant's fill on hover. Aliases Alpha/Olive-10 on Light, Alpha/White-10 on Dark/Feature.

highlight-hover.note: Button accent variant's fill on hover. Mode-invariant.

disabled.note: Not yet used by any built component.

default.note: Button secondary variant's resting border; also the resting border for every Input-family control.

subtle.note: Hover-state border color for every Input-family control.

strong.note: Not yet used by any built component.

focus.note: Focus-ring border for Button primary/secondary/link and every Input-family control. Mode-aware — replaces the old fixed value plus separate border-focus-inverse/border-focus-on-feature tokens; a container's data-mode resolves the correct pairing.

focus-on-highlight.note: Button accent's Focused-state ring only — border-focus fails WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 against accent's action-highlight fill. Mode-invariant.

primary.note: Default body text color; also the typed-value color for Input-family controls when focused.

secondary.note: Not yet used by any built component.

muted.note: Placeholder text color for Input-family controls; also Checkbox's disabled-state checkmark/label color.

link.note: Not yet used by any built component — Button's link variant binds to text-button instead, a pre-existing divergence.

button.note: Button link's Default state. Link's Hover/Focused state does NOT use this token or its mode resolution — see Button.tsx's own comment: the old text-button-inverse 'brighter on hover' token has no successor in the mode system, since modes model surface context, not same-page hover state. Kept as a literal hex value there pending a design-side decision.

on-action.note: Button primary's label text. Inverted in lockstep with action.primary.

on-state.note: Text that sits on a state-colored fill (Badge's success/warning/error variants). Mode-invariant by design — a badge's fixed dark/saturated fill always pairs with the same light text regardless of the page's ambient mode; Badge deliberately does not set its own data-mode.

primary.note: Mode-invariant. Not yet used by any built component.

secondary.note: Mode-invariant. Not yet used by any built component.

tertiary.note: Mode-invariant. Not yet used by any built component.

feature.note: Card's fill — always this exact terracotta regardless of page mode, which is why Card sets data-mode="feature" on its own root so everything nested inside resolves the correct pairing. Mode-invariant.

scrim.note: For modal/overlay backdrops. Not yet used by any built component (no Modal built yet). Mode-invariant.

card.note: Not yet used by any built component.

subtle.note: Not yet used by any built component.

hover.note: Mode-invariant. Not yet used by any built component directly.

disabled.note: Border color for Input-family controls in the disabled state; also Button link's disabled-state label text.

focus.note: Not yet used by any built component directly — border-focus is what components reference for focus-ring styling.

warning.note: Badge's Warning variant background — pinned to its On Light value regardless of ambient mode (Badge doesn't set its own data-mode), paired with the mode-invariant text-on-state.

success.note: Badge's Success variant background. Same pinned-to-On-Light convention as state.warning.

error.note: Badge's Error variant background. Same pinned-to-On-Light convention as state.warning.

primary.note: Not yet used by any built component.

secondary.note: Not yet used by any built component.

muted.note: Not yet used by any built component.

interactive.note: Tab's Active/Hover indicator (confirmed against a live Figma screenshot — renders as a dark muted amber, not action-highlight's bright orange).

on-action.note: Not yet used by any built component.

disabled.note: Not yet used by any built component.

800.note: Darkened from #c4582a in the 2026-07-19 token sync so surface-feature keeps AA text contrast. Renumbered from Terracotta/100 to Terracotta/800 in the 2026-08-05 primitive renumbering.

950.note: The darkest amber step, ensuring text-highlight/border-focus/state-focus/text-link/text-button reach AA contrast on light surfaces. Renumbered from Amber/25 to Amber/950 in the 2026-08-05 primitive renumbering (light->dark convention).

850.note: Aliased by surface.card and surface.subtle's Dark mode.

800.note: Aliased by state.success's On Light value.

700.note: Aliased by state.error's On Light value.

200.note: Aliased by border.focus/state.focus's Dark and Feature values.

olive-20.note: Defined-but-unused: reserved for overlays and scrims, not text-bearing surfaces.

olive-40.note: Defined-but-unused: reserved for overlays and scrims, not text-bearing surfaces.

olive-60.note: Defined-but-unused: reserved for overlays and scrims, not text-bearing surfaces.

disabled.note: Figma's opacity/disabled variable (mode-based token architecture, see design-system-rules.md §2/§7) — the MD3-pattern disabled treatment: default appearance at reduced opacity, never a separate disabled colour set. Mode-invariant (always 38%).

standard.note: Not Figma-sourced (the file has no motion variables). Formalizes the identical transition-colors duration-150 ease-out already used in Button/Input/Select/Textarea/Checkbox.

shadow.note: No shadow tokens are defined. The Figma source file has zero effect styles, and no component in this system currently uses box-shadow. This is an accurate empty state, not an omission — see the Shadows foundation page.

tablet.note: Not Figma-sourced (no breakpoint variables exist in the file) and not yet used by any of the 6 built components (none are responsive). Formalizes the one breakpoint value already used repeatedly across the pre-existing app shell (src/index.css, src/App.css). Tailwind's own default scale (sm 640px / md 768px / lg 1024px / xl 1280px / 2xl 1536px) is available but not customized or formally adopted by this design system.
